# Wordmark

The Grow Good mark, chosen by variant from the approved logo rows of the asset register.

Include `gg/wordmark.html` · Figma: Wordmark · Formats: web, flyer, postcard, social · Decisions: D-025, D-037 · Rules: NAMES-001 · Reads site data: `assets.logos`

The contract is `_data/components/wordmark.yml` (COMP-002). Sources are explained in [Components](../../brand/system/components.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | enum: primary | no | primary | assets | Matches the style column of a logo row. New variants arrive as register rows (D-037). |
| `href` | url | no |  | site | Set to link the mark home. |
